'''Clangnaga''' is a [[Rock]] type [[DPS]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves from [[Rattlecoil]] at 18 stars, and evolves into Dharmadder at 36 stars after completing their specific [[trials|evolution trials]].

==Overview==
Current Description: "Clangnaga now has quite a few followers, with Tatari lining up to confess minor trespasses. Honestly, it's a pretty good life - fight some [[Zobos]], hear some gossip - not bad at all. Tap tap!"

Clangnaga is a red rarity Tatari.

==Appearance==
TBA

==Evolution Trial==
Clangnaga's evolution trial unlocks when it reaches 36 stars. To evolve it into [[Dharmadder]] you need to complete the following three tasks:
* Feed this Tatari to B quality.
* Play [[Treasure Hunt]] (Dig up treasure x120) or [[Cozy Farm]] (Use Fertilizer x7200).
* In Tatari Catcher, capture 200 Tatari. Let their souls flourish!

* Prior to the update on 5/12/2026, its bio description said: "Rapidly striking the head can calm Tatari nearby. Even [[Glideflip]] tends to grow calm in the presence of Clangnaga."
